Sound of Hope FAQ

Is Sound of Hope still on shortwave?
Yes. As of November 14, 2026, Sound of Hope is in the B-26 shortwave schedule with 656 scheduled broadcasts on 67 frequencies (6230, 6280, 6850, 6865, 6900, 6970 kHz and more). The schedule comes from EIBI and is rebuilt daily; stations can change frequencies at short notice.

What frequency is Sound of Hope on?
In the B-26 season Sound of Hope is scheduled on 67 shortwave frequencies, including 6230, 6280, 6850, 6865, 6900, 6970 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 9300 kHz (7 pm – 8 pm Eastern). For Europe: 9300 kHz (10:30 pm – 11 pm UTC+1).

What time is Sound of Hope on shortwave?
Sound of Hope is scheduled in 14 UTC time windows this season, from 00:00–01:00 UTC through 23:00–24h UTC. No English broadcasts are listed this season. All times are UTC; subtract your UTC offset for local time.

Can I hear Sound of Hope in the USA?
It isn't beamed at North America this season, so hearing it in the USA is a DX catch. Your best chance is 9300 kHz (7 pm – 8 pm Eastern) when that band is open, or listen through an online receiver (KiwiSDR/WebSDR) closer to its target area.

Does Sound of Hope broadcast in English on shortwave?
Not this season. Sound of Hope is scheduled in Mandarin, Cantonese.

Is Sound of Hope on the air right now?
As of Saturday, November 14, 2026, 20:40 UTC, Sound of Hope is scheduled to be broadcasting on 6230 kHz to Far East. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
